# Simulate dates and covariates

## Dates

```{r}
set.seed(3111963)
# define N
n=1e5
# define start and end of registry
start_date=as.Date("2005-01-01")
end_date=as.Date("2022-12-31")
max_days=as.numeric(end_date - start_date)
# simulate dates
backward_days=rtruncexp(n=n,
                        rate=0.0002,
                        max=max_days)
# calculate onset date
onsetdatev=end_date-floor(backward_days)
# see distribution
hist(as.numeric(onsetdatev),
     breaks = 100,
     main = "Time before end date",
     xlab = "Date of onset (numeric)")
abline(v=as.numeric(as.Date('2021-05-31')),col="red",lty=2,lwd=2)
```

## Covariates

```{r}
covs=data.frame(id=1:n,
                dateonset=onsetdatev,
              aoo=runif(n,0,8),
              event=1,
              u=runif(n,0,1),
              e=rnorm(n,0.5,0.02),
              sex=sample(c('male','female'),n,replace=T))
```

Expand with time

```{r}
set.seed(181299)
t=seq(0,2190,by=182.625)
id=1:n
# expand time
tid=expand.grid(id=id,time=t)
# merge with covariates
df=merge(covs,tid,by='id') %>% 
  arrange(id,time) %>% 
  mutate(terr=ifelse(time==0,0,runif(n,0,+90)),
         date=dateonset+time+terr,
         yoo=year(dateonset),
         yoo_c=yoo-mean(yoo))
# define random intercept
df=df %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  mutate(row=row_number(),
         u0 = rnorm(1,0,0.07),         
         epsilon = rnorm(n(),0,0.08)) %>% ungroup()
```

Simulate outcome

```{r}
# population constants, computed once and outside any grouping
b0=0.95-(0.009*mean(df$aoo)-0.042*mean(df$sex=="male")+0.096*mean(df$yoo_c))

df=df %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  mutate(trialdate=as.Date("2021-05-31"),
         trt_yoo=ifelse(date>=trialdate,1,0),
         ptrt_conf=1/(1+exp(-(0 - 0.346*aoo + 1.49*I(sex=='male')))),
         trt_conf=rbinom(1,1,ptrt_conf),
         trt=ifelse(trt_conf == 1 & trt_yoo == 1,1,0),
         trt_overall=ifelse(sum(trt)>=1,1,0)) %>% 
  ungroup()
# delete historical controls with onset after the trial starts
df=df %>% 
  mutate(flag=ifelse(trt_overall==0 & trt_yoo==1,1,0)) %>% 
  filter(flag==0)
# start of the trial and duration
df=df %>% 
  arrange(desc(trt_overall),id,date) %>% 
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(lastvisit=max(date),
         starttrial=as.Date(ifelse(any(trt == 1),
                                   min(date[trt == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
                                   as.Date(NA))),
         duration=ifelse(trt_overall==1,
                         as.numeric(starttrial-dateonset)/365.25,
                         as.numeric(lastvisit-dateonset)/365.25)) %>%
  ungroup()
# loop to redefine dates
for (i in 2:nrow(df)){
  if (df$trt[i]==1 & df$id[i]==df$id[i-1] & df$date[i]!=df$starttrial[i]){
    df$date[i]=df$date[i-1]+90
  } 
}
# time, outcome and treatment effect, AFTER the dates are final
df=df %>% 
  mutate(timen=as.numeric(date-dateonset)/365.25,
         timen_trt=ifelse(trt==0,0,as.numeric(date-starttrial)/365.25),
         hui_linear_untrt=(b0+u0)+0.009*aoo-0.042*(sex=="male")+0.096*yoo_c-0.1*timen+epsilon,
         hui_linear_trt=hui_linear_untrt+0.05*trt*timen_trt) %>% 
  group_by(id,trt) %>% 
  filter(!(trt==1 & !(row_number() %in% c(1,2,3,5,7,9)))) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

See differences in SMDs

```{r}
# create baseline
baseline=df %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  filter(row_number()==1) %>% 
  ungroup()
# smd
smd(baseline$aoo,baseline$trt_overall)
smd(baseline$sex,baseline$trt_overall)
```

Match and see bias

```{r}
matched=duration_matching_interpolation(data=df,identifier=id,
                                        y=hui_linear_trt,
                 treatment=trt_overall,
                 duration=duration,time=timen,
                 ratio=2)
```

Get estimates and bias

```{r}
# model
trial=matched$interpolated %>% 
  filter(time_aligned<=2) %>%
  lmer(y~(1|cluster)+(1|cluster:id)+trt*time_aligned+yoo,.)
# contrast
estimand=emmeans(trial, ~ trt | time_aligned,
                              at = list(time_aligned=2))
# see contrast
ate=summary(contrast(estimand, method="trt.vs.ctrl", ref=1))$estimate[1]
# bias
(ate-0.1)/0.1
```
